For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
I was crying to God with my voice; even to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.
（亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。）我要向神發聲呼求；我向神發聲，他必留心聽我。
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
In the day of my trouble, my heart was turned to the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night without resting; my soul would not be comforted.
我在患難之日尋求主；我在夜間不住地舉手禱告；我的心不肯受安慰。
I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
I will keep God in memory, with sounds of grief; my thoughts are troubled, and my spirit is overcome. (Selah.)
我想念神，就煩躁不安；我沉吟悲傷，心便發昏。（細拉）
You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
You keep my eyes from sleep; I am so troubled that no words come.
你叫我不能閉眼；我煩亂不安，甚至不能說話。
I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
My thoughts go back to the days of the past, to the years which are gone.
我追想古時之日，上古之年。
At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
The memory of my song comes back to me in the night; my thoughts are moving in my heart; my spirit is searching with care.
我想起我夜間的歌曲，捫心自問；我心裡也仔細省察。
“Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
Will the Lord put me away for ever? will he be kind no longer?
難道主要永遠丟棄我，不再施恩嗎？
Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
Is his mercy quite gone for ever? has his word come to nothing?
難道他的慈愛永遠窮盡，他的應許世世廢棄嗎？
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
Has God put away the memory of his pity? are his mercies shut up by his wrath? (Selah.)
難道神忘記開恩，因發怒就止住他的慈悲嗎？（細拉）
So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
And I said, It is a weight on my spirit; but I will keep in mind the years of the right hand of the Most High.
我便說：這是我的懦弱，但我要追念至高者顯出右手之年代。
I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
I will keep in mind the works of Jah: I will keep the memory of your wonders in the past.
我要提說耶和華所行的；我要記念你古時的奇事。
I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
I will give thought to all your work, while my mind goes over your acts of power.
我也要思想你的經營，默念你的作為。
Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
Your way, O God, is holy: what god is so great as our God?
神啊，你的作為是潔淨的；有何神大如神呢？
You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
You are the God who does works of power: you have made your strength clear to the nations.
你是行奇事的神；你曾在列邦中彰顯你的能力。
With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
With your arm you have made your people free, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)
你曾用你的膀臂贖了你的民，就是雅各和約瑟的子孫。（細拉）
The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you, they were in fear: even the deep was troubled.
神啊，諸水見你，一見就都驚惶；深淵也都戰抖。
The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
The clouds sent out water; the skies gave out a sound; truly, your arrows went far and wide.
雲中倒出水來；天空發出響聲；你的箭也飛行四方。
Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
The voice of your thunder went rolling on; the world was flaming with the light of the storm; the earth was shaking.
你的雷聲在旋風中；電光照亮世界；大地戰抖震動。
Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
Your way was in the sea, and your road in the great waters; there was no knowledge of your footsteps.
你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的腳蹤無人知道。
You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
You were guiding your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
你曾藉摩西和亞倫的手引導你的百姓，好像羊群一般。
